summary: Produced compiled TikZ version 2 for the semicircle figure. It has a baseline from an unlabelled left end through V to A, a vertical chord V–C–B, segment C–A, and a solid upper semicircle arc centred at V from A through B to the left end. Labels A, B, C, V are placed correctly. The critic scored it 0.95 with no must-repair issues, and the topology check passes. No right-angle mark is drawn at V, since the original shows none.
